dogecoin.text:
What's the worst thing you could say on a first date? I'll start: 

“Have you heard of #Dogecoin it’s a dog-themed cryptocurrency and it’s for the people, it’s decentralized and coins are issued at a fixed rate, @ElonMusk is a big fan, we’re going to the moon”

@CoinDesk @mcuban @TheEllenShow @_cameronhood If by learning to understand crypto you mean losing all your money because you bought an abandoned memecoin with an infinite supply that is on its way back to sub $.01, just because kids on social media told you to, then yes, buying #dogecoin is very educational.
